task.description:
Resolve the SCH-04 blocker reported by WF02-sch04-20260523 step-04.

Verified failure:
- `zig build test-integration -- --test-filter SCH-04` fails at compile time because `src/scheduler/scheduler.zig` returns `error.InvalidUuid` from `parseEscalationPayload` but the declared error set omits it.

Required outcome:
- Fix the compile defect at the root cause without broadening scope unnecessarily.
- Re-run the focused SCH-04 validation path sufficiently to prove the blocker is removed.
- Update the handoff with PASS/FAIL and artifact outputs, including any inner report produced.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- focused SCH-04 integration validation compiles and runs
acceptance_criteria: The scheduler error-set mismatch is corrected at the root cause
Focused SCH-04 integration validation no longer fails at compile time

result.summary: Fixed SCH-04 scheduler escalation handling by mapping UUID parse failures into the local payload error set and correcting escalation timer insert SQL/payload typing so the focused SCH-04 validation path compiles and runs end-to-end.
